description: A Hacker News story page: the story plus a page of its comment thread. HN serves the whole thread in one document, so the lens windows it client-side (default 30 comments/page); next_page is the same lens at the next window (null on the last page). Pass args {p, limit} to control the window.

resolve.prompt: This is a Hacker News story page. Return {story: {title, url, score}, comments: [{author, age, text}], next_page}. Return at most 30 comments in reading order. If you can see more than 30 comments on the page, set next_page to the URL of this page with the query param &p=2 appended (page 2 of the client-side window); otherwise set next_page to null. Include only fields you can actually see.
